name: InstallatørGruppen A/S
summary: InstallatørGruppen A/S operates as a technical installation group in Denmark and Switzerland. The company offers services, such as in the fields of plumbing, heating, ventilation and air conditioning, refrigeration and electrical systems, cooling and adjacent disciplines as well as in selected specialist areas, including sprinkler systems, energy optimization, building automation, fibre-optic infrastructure and solar panel installations. The company serves residential, commercial, industrial, and public-sector building markets. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Roskilde, Denmark.
